alt: Medical provider confirms agreement to draft a clinical support letter for the CDSS to secure an expedited state hearing, acknowledging the administrative hurdles faced by the patient.
full_text:
The state portal accepts document uploads. Just wanted to flag the specific legal standard CDSS is looking for so the letter can address it if you feel it's appropriate. I'm sorry that I'm asking for so much, whatever day that you have the time to do this is fine! Thank you as always. -Nick

Glad you got the meds! Lots of hoops to work through. Yes, I can write a letter with such information to express expedited review. [Name redacted] NP

Thanks [Name redacted]. It's been rough here. Not looking good. - Nick
summary: Medical provider confirms agreement to draft a clinical support letter for the CDSS to secure an expedited state hearing, acknowledging the administrative hurdles faced by the patient.
